notes: Seed http://www.co.dawson.tx.us/ works over https; results are on page/dawson.Election.Information. No Clarity or vendor link. Files are scanned Hart reports named by scanner timestamp; Last-Modified values differ per file and look like real upload times (the 2024 'UNOFFICIAL TOTALS' Last-Modified is the next afternoon, later than its scan time, possibly a re-upload). The county posted only county totals for the 2024 general but per-precinct unofficial reports on runoff night. 2026 primary undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none.
tag_rationale: The 2024 general is LATER and the 2026 runoff is END (both check 2); no two elections share a result, so by the rule the tag is UNKNOWN. Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.

2024_general.fact: Two 2024 general files are linked: an unlabeled scanned Hart 'Cumulative Results Report DAWSON COUNTY, TEXAS GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 Unofficial Results' with 'Run Time 7:09 PM' and zero Election Day votes (Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 01:25:56 GMT, 7:25 PM CST), and 'UNOFFICIAL TOTALS', the same county-total report with 'Run Time 8:32 PM' including Election Day votes (scanner file name 20241105220214, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 19:38:25 GMT). No 2024 general precinct-level file is posted.

2026_primary.fact: No March 3, 2026 primary results files are listed on the Election Information page (only notices). Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: 'REPUBLICAN UNOFFICIAL PRECINCT RESULTS' is a scanned Hart 'PRECINCT RESULTS REPORT DAWSON COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION 5/26/2026 Unofficial Results ... Run Time 9:35 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' with per-precinct candidate votes including Election Day Voting (precinct 1: Ken Paxton 53 = 1 absentee, 27 early, 25 election day). PDF CreationDate 2026-05-27 02:50:18 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:54:14 GMT (9:54 PM CDT). A matching 'DEMOCRATIC UNOFFICIAL PRECINCT RESULTS' (20260526214924.pdf) and cumulative files are listed; official files followed on 6-4-2026. Rule 47: publication shown by upload time 2026-05-26 21:54 CT in 20260526215018.pdf.
